1 September 2026
SB Energy, Inc.
("SB Energy" or the "Company")
Potential UK Retail Offer for Proposed US IPO

Following the Company's public filing of a Registration Statement on Form S-1 (the "Registration Statement") with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to the proposed initial public offering of its shares of common stock, Marex Financial ("Marex") is pleased to announce that the Company is proposing to undertake a public offer of shares to retail investors who are tax resident and located in the United Kingdom ("UK Retail Investors") via a public offer platform operated by Marex in accordance with the rules of the UK Financial Conduct Authority.

If the proposed offering proceeds, a further announcement will be made by Marex to announce the launch of the UK retail offer in due course. UK Retail Investors will be able to take part in the proposed UK retail offer via a group of participating retail intermediaries appointed by Marex.

The proposed offering is subject to market and other conditions, including the Registration Statement becoming effective, and there can be no assurance as to whether or when the proposed offering may be completed, or as to the actual size or terms of the proposed offering.
About SB Energy

SB Energy is a power-first, community-focused infrastructure company purpose built for the AI economy. We develop, build, and own gigawatt-scale data center and power capacity, addressing the industry's primary bottleneck and accelerating speed-to-compute.

Investors should undertake their own investigations into the merits of an investment in the Company. Nothing in this announcement amounts to a recommendation to invest in the Company or amounts to investment, tax or legal advice.

It should be noted that an application for shares and investment in the Company carries a number of risks. Investors should take independent advice from a person experienced in advising on investment in securities such as the shares if they are in any doubt.
